# Fixtures

Eight responses (NDC 17.2): four AirShopping (`one_way_*`, `round_trip_*`) and four OrderView (`order_*`) from IATA's sample messages, used unchanged:
one-way and round-trip, with one and two passengers. Source: the `ndc-xml-172` sample
repository of the IATA NDC developer portal, published under the MIT license (see `LICENSE`).

`shopping_213.xml` is not an IATA sample: it is a small NDC 21.3 AirShopping response written by hand
(three offers) and checked against the 21.3 schema.
